Class EmergencyVehicle

java.lang.Object
traffic.model.Vehicle
traffic.model.EmergencyVehicle
All Implemented Interfaces:

Direct Known Subclasses:

public class EmergencyVehicle extends Vehicle
Ambulance / police / fire truck. Moves faster and may force waiting cars out of its way.
